user.title: Choose connection
user.description: Choose how the wallbox is connected. Setup only reads values and does not change charging settings.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Choose the connection type, then update its details. This does not change the bus address stored in the controller.

connection.title: Connect ABL Wallbox
connection.description: Enter the connection details. RS485 uses 38400 baud, 8E1. Shelly requires the supplied UART bridge script; its HTTP port is usually 80.

error.cannot_connect: No valid controller reply. Check the address, connection and physical serial settings.
error.bridge_busy: Another program occupies the bridge. Disconnect the ABL PC software, COM redirector and other integrations.
error.invalid_connection: Enter a hostname without http:// or a serial device path.
